firstAppearance: R4 / 2026-09-30 / component inventory and taste summary
countingRule: Library entries, including blocks/hook; four variants and PULSAR copies are not extra component names. Semantic overlap across libraries is retained, not deduplicated.

entries.name: AnimatedContent
entries.description: Wrapper that animates any children on scroll or mount with configurable direction, distance, duration, easing and disappear options.

entries.name: Antigravity
entries.description: 3D antigravity particle field that repels from the cursor with smooth motion.

entries.name: BlobCursor
entries.description: Organic blob cursor that smoothly follows the pointer with inertia and elastic morphing.

entries.name: ClickSpark
entries.description: Creates particle spark bursts at click position.

entries.name: Crosshair
entries.description: Custom crosshair cursor with tracking, and link hover effects.

entries.name: Cubes
entries.description: 3D rotating cube cluster. Supports auto-rotation or hover interaction.

entries.name: CursorGrid
entries.description: Canvas grid whose cells light up around the cursor with configurable radius, falloff and click pulses.

entries.name: DitherVeil
entries.description: A photo printed as a 1-bit dither that the cursor burns through to full colour, leaving a trail that knits back cell by cell.

entries.name: ElasticMesh
entries.description: Spring-mesh surface that stretches under the pointer and settles back with damped physics.

entries.name: ElectricBorder
entries.description: Jittery electric energy border with animated arcs, glow and adjustable intensity.

entries.name: ElectricLogo
entries.description: Turns any SVG or PNG into a living lightning outline, with flowing strands, arcs that leap off the edges and a charge that follows the cursor.

entries.name: FadeContent
entries.description: Simple directional fade / slide entrance / exit wrapper with threshold-based activation.

entries.name: GhostCursor
entries.description: Semi-transparent ghost cursor that smoothly follows the real cursor with a trailing effect.

entries.name: GlareHover
entries.description: Adds a realistic moving glare highlight on hover over any element.

entries.name: GlowCursor
entries.description: Shader-powered light trail that smoothly follows the pointer with customizable glow, color, taper and pulse.

entries.name: GradualBlur
entries.description: Progressively un-blurs content based on scroll or trigger creating a cinematic reveal.

entries.name: HalftoneReveal
entries.description: Print-style halftone dot matrix that resolves into sharp content around the cursor.

entries.name: ImageTrail
entries.description: Cursor-based image trail with several built-in variants.

entries.name: LaserFlow
entries.description: Dynamic laser light that flows onto a surface, customizable effect.

entries.name: LogoLoop
entries.description: Continuously looping marquee of brand or tech logos with seamless repeat and hover pause.

entries.name: MagicRings
entries.description: Interactive magic rings effect with customizable parameters.

entries.name: Magnet
entries.description: Elements magnetically ease toward the cursor then settle back with spring physics.

entries.name: MagnetLines
entries.description: Animated field lines bend toward the cursor.

entries.name: MetaBalls
entries.description: Liquid metaball blobs that merge and separate with smooth implicit surface animation.

entries.name: MetallicPaint
entries.description: Liquid metallic paint shader which can be applied to SVG elements.

entries.name: Noise
entries.description: Animated film grain / noise overlay adding subtle texture and motion.

entries.name: OrbitImages
entries.description: SVG Path customizable orbiting images effect

entries.name: PixelSwap
entries.description: Pixel fragments assemble into a full cover, swap arbitrary content, then dissolve away with reversible colors and triggers.

entries.name: PixelTrail
entries.description: Pixelated cursor trail emitting fading squares with retro digital feel.

entries.name: PixelTransition
entries.description: Pixel dissolve transition for content reveal on hover.

entries.name: Ribbons
entries.description: Flowing responsive ribbons/cursor trail driven by physics and pointer motion.

entries.name: RippleDistortion
entries.description: Pointer-driven water displacement that warps content and leaves a decaying wake.

entries.name: ScrollExpand
entries.description: A rounded media frame that grows to full bleed as it scrolls through the viewport.

entries.name: ShapeBlur
entries.description: Morphing blurred geometric shape. The effect occurs on hover.

entries.name: SplashCursor
entries.description: Liquid splash burst at cursor with curling ripples and waves.

entries.name: StarBorder
entries.description: Animated star / sparkle border orbiting content with twinkle pulses.

entries.name: StickerPeel
entries.description: Sticker corner lift + peel interaction using 3D transform and shadow depth.

entries.name: Strands
entries.description: Glowing ribbon-like strands that ripple and weave across a transparent canvas.

entries.name: SwarmCursor
entries.description: Flocking particle swarm that chases the pointer, jostles for space and drifts apart at rest.

entries.name: TargetCursor
entries.description: A cursor follow animation with 4 corners that lock onto targets.

entries.name: AcidSquares
entries.description: A crystalline corridor of stacked squares receding into depth.

entries.name: AeroShards
entries.description: A GPU-driven wind sculpture of folded foil shards with crisp detail, content-safe placements, and responsive pointer interactions.

entries.name: Aurora
entries.description: Flowing aurora gradient background.

entries.name: Balatro
entries.description: The balatro shader, fully customizalbe and interactive.

entries.name: Ballpit
entries.description: Physics ball pit simulation with bouncing colorful spheres.

entries.name: Beams
entries.description: Crossing animated ribbons with customizable properties.

entries.name: ColorBends
entries.description: Vibrant color bends with smooth flowing animation.

entries.name: CRTWarp
entries.description: Full-canvas CRT plasma with curved distortion, scanlines, bloom and pointer interaction.

entries.name: DarkVeil
entries.description: Subtle dark background with a smooth animation and postprocessing.

entries.name: Dither
entries.description: Retro dithered noise shader background.

entries.name: DotField
entries.description: Interactive dot grid with cursor bulge, glow, sparkle, and wave effects.

entries.name: DotGrid
entries.description: Animated dot grid with cursor interactions.

entries.name: EvilEye
entries.description: Procedural evil eye shader with animated iris, slit pupil, and fiery outer glow.

entries.name: FaultyTerminal
entries.description: Terminal CRT scanline squares effect with flicker + noise.

entries.name: Ferrofluid
entries.description: A churning magnetic fluid traced by glowing contour lines, with a cursor magnet.

entries.name: FloatingLines
entries.description: 3D floating lines that react to cursor movement.

entries.name: Galaxy
entries.description: Parallax realistic starfield with pointer interactions.

entries.name: GhostFibers
entries.description: A deep-blue recursive fiber field with luminous bands, radial twisting and soft atmospheric glow.

entries.name: GradientBlinds
entries.description: Layered gradient blinds with spotlight and noise distortion.

entries.name: GradientWaves
entries.description: Raymarched sine waves rolling toward a soft, hazy horizon.

entries.name: Grainient
entries.description: Grainy gradient swirls with soft wave distortion.

entries.name: GridDistortion
entries.description: Warped grid mesh distorts smoothly reacting to cursor.

entries.name: GridMotion
entries.description: Perspective moving grid lines based on cusror position.

entries.name: GridScan
entries.description: Animated grid room 3D scan effect and cool interactions.

entries.name: Hyperspeed
entries.description: Animated lines continuously moving to simulate hyperspace travel on click hold.

entries.name: Iridescence
entries.description: Slick iridescent shader with shifting waves.

entries.name: LetterGlitch
entries.description: Matrix style letter animation.

entries.name: Lightfall
entries.description: Colorful light streaks raining down a glowing tunnel with a cursor light.

entries.name: Lightning
entries.description: Procedural lightning bolts with branching and glow flicker.

entries.name: LightPillar
entries.description: Vertical pillar of light with glow effects.

entries.name: LightRays
entries.description: Volumetric light rays/beams with customizable direction.

entries.name: LightTunnel
entries.description: A radial fibre-optic tunnel with light pulses racing into depth.

entries.name: LineWaves
entries.description: Animated line wave pattern with colorful warped distortion.

entries.name: LiquidChrome
entries.description: Liquid metallic chrome shader with flowing reflective surface.

entries.name: LiquidEther
entries.description: Interactive liquid shader with flowing distortion and customizable colors.

entries.name: MicroSlats
entries.description: A wall of tiny slats that becomes a rolling sea in perspective, with glinting crests, four presets, a real fluid the cursor stirs and an intro that rolls in from the horizon.

entries.name: MoltenMetal
entries.description: Swirling caustic plasma filaments with molten, white-hot cores.

entries.name: Orb
entries.description: Floating energy orb with customizable hover effect.

entries.name: Particles
entries.description: Configurable particle system.

entries.name: PixelBlast
entries.description: Exploding pixel particle bursts with optional liquid postprocessing.

entries.name: PixelSnow
entries.description: Falling pixelated snow effect with customizable density and speed.

entries.name: Plasma
entries.description: Organic plasma gradients swirl + morph with smooth turbulence.

entries.name: PlasmaWave
entries.description: Raymarched plasma waves with dual-wave interference and OGL.

entries.name: Prism
entries.description: Rotating prism with configurable intensity, size, and colors.

entries.name: PrismaticBurst
entries.description: Burst of light rays with controllable color, distortion, amount.

entries.name: Radar
entries.description: Radar sweep effect with concentric rings, radial spokes, and a rotating beam.

entries.name: RippleGrid
entries.description: A grid that continuously animates with a ripple effect.

entries.name: Scanner
entries.description: Calm interference bands sweeping across the screen like an oscilloscope.

entries.name: ShapeGrid
entries.description: Animated grid with shape variants (square, hexagon, circle, triangle) + direction customization.

entries.name: ShapeWaves
entries.description: A WebGPU field of triangles, circles and squares that brighten and grow along rolling waves, with an optional text cutout the waves flow around.

entries.name: SideRays
entries.description: Animated light rays emanating from the side with customizable colors and speed.

entries.name: Silk
entries.description: Smooth waves background with soft lighting.

entries.name: SlicedWaves
entries.description: A grid of soft glowing bars rippling like a slatted equalizer.

entries.name: SoftAurora
entries.description: Soft aurora borealis shader with 3D Perlin noise and cosine gradient palettes.

entries.name: Threads
entries.description: Animated pattern of lines forming a fabric-like motion.

entries.name: Topography
entries.description: A living contour map with glowing, elevation-tinted lines.

entries.name: Waves
entries.description: Layered lines that form smooth wave patterns with animation.

entries.name: WebThreads
entries.description: Glowing sine threads woven through a luminous convergence point.

entries.name: AccordionGallery
entries.description: Panels expand on hover or focus, revealing parallax imagery and captions.

entries.name: AnimatedList
entries.description: List items enter with staggered motion variants for polished reveals.

entries.name: ApertureReveal
entries.description: A circular aperture opens through an editorial cover to reveal real content. Pointer, focus and an explicit toggle share the same reversible reveal.

entries.name: BauhausStepper
entries.description: Primary-color geometric step selector with independent navigation and a sliding progress rule.

entries.name: BeamPath
entries.description: Animated packets travel on curved SVG paths into a glowing hub. Caller labels and real children stay independent of the decorative circuit.

entries.name: BlueprintPanel
entries.description: A technical blueprint disclosure card with dimension annotations, grid paper and an expanding specification panel.

entries.name: BorderGlow
entries.description: Glowing mesh-gradient border that follows cursor direction and intensifies near edges.

entries.name: BounceCards
entries.description: Cards bounce that bounce in on mount.

entries.name: BubbleMenu
entries.description: Floating circular expanding menu with staggered item reveal.

entries.name: CardNav
entries.description: Expandable navigation bar with card panels revealing nested links.

entries.name: CardSwap
entries.description: Cards animate position swapping with smooth layout transitions.

entries.name: Carousel
entries.description: Responsive carousel with touch gestures, looping and transitions.

entries.name: ChromaGrid
entries.description: A responsive grid of grayscale tiles. Hovering the grid reaveals their colors.

entries.name: CircularGallery
entries.description: Circular orbit gallery rotating images.

entries.name: ConveyorGallery
entries.description: A continuous diagonal film strip carries caller artwork. Hover or keyboard focus pauses it; every original card remains accessible in a static list.
entries.style: Analog film strip / 模拟胶片

entries.name: Counter
entries.description: Flexible animated counter supporting increments + easing.

entries.name: CurvedInput
entries.description: Arc-bent input bar with text, caret and submit button all following the curve.

entries.name: DecayCard
entries.description: Hover parallax effect that disintegrates the content of a card.

entries.name: DepthCarousel
entries.description: Cards recede into depth on a 3D rail, with drag, keyboard and auto-advance.

entries.name: DepthLiftCard
entries.description: A holographic card whose frame, rings and foreground rise at different depths while tracking the pointer. Tap or press Enter to hold the lifted view.

entries.name: Dock
entries.description: macOS style magnifying dock with proximity scaling of icons.

entries.name: DomeGallery
entries.description: Immersive 3D dome gallery projecting images on a hemispheric surface.

entries.name: DriftWall
entries.description: An endless perspective wall of tiles drifting past, lifting on hover.

entries.name: ElasticSlider
entries.description: Slider handle stretches elastically then snaps with spring physics.

entries.name: FlexCarousel
entries.description: An infinite image row that flows through invisible liquid glass at its edges, with four bend presets, five entrances, a speed squeeze and click to focus.

entries.name: FlowingMenu
entries.description: Liquid flowing active indicator glides between menu items.

entries.name: FluidGlass
entries.description: Glassmorphism container with animated liquid distortion refraction.

entries.name: FlyingPosters
entries.description: 3D posters rotate on scroll infinitely.

entries.name: Folder
entries.description: Interactive folder opens to reveal nested content smooth motion.

entries.name: GlassIcons
entries.description: Icon set styled with frosted glass blur.

entries.name: GlassSurface
entries.description: Advanced Apple-style glass surface with real-time distortion + lighting.

entries.name: GooeyNav
entries.description: Navigation indicator morphs with gooey blob transitions between items.

entries.name: InfiniteMenu
entries.description: Horizontally looping menu effect that scrolls endlessly with seamless wrap.

entries.name: InfiniteSpiral
entries.description: An endlessly looping 3D helix of images with customizable motion, depth, spacing and interaction.

entries.name: KineticTiles
entries.description: A grid ripples away from the pointer: nearby tiles lift, rotate and spring apart. Keyboard focus lifts a tile and selection is a caller callback.
entries.style: Neo brutalist playground / 新粗野主义操场

entries.name: Lanyard
entries.description: Swinging 3D lanyard / badge card with realistic inertial motion.

entries.name: LineSidebar
entries.description: Static list navigation with a cursor-proximity effect that shifts and highlights nearby items.

entries.name: LiquidAction
entries.description: A spring-following action sits inside orbiting liquid droplets. Hover or keyboard focus merges the droplets into a wide halo; activation belongs to the caller.

entries.name: MagicBento
entries.description: Interactive bento grid tiles expand + animate with various options.

entries.name: Masonry
entries.description: Responsive masonry layout with animated reflow + gaps optimization.

entries.name: ModelViewer
entries.description: Three.js model viewer with orbit controls and lighting presets.

entries.name: MonoCommand
entries.description: A compact monochrome command surface with immediate search, native buttons, keyboard result navigation and recoverable empty state.

entries.name: MorphSlider
entries.description: WebGL slider that melts between images with a displacement transition.

entries.name: OptionWheel
entries.description: Curved option picker that spins via scroll, drag, or arrow keys, fading and tilting items away from the selection.

entries.name: OrbitStage
entries.description: Caller-provided subjects orbit a central stage. Select any subject to update the central content; pause, focus or reduced motion freezes the orbits without losing selection.

entries.name: OrigamiNav
entries.description: A paper-strip navigation that folds open from a stable trigger; collapsed links are inert.

entries.name: PillNav
entries.description: Minimal pill nav with sliding active highlight + smooth easing.

entries.name: PixelCard
entries.description: Card content revealed through pixel expansion transition.

entries.name: PrismDeck
entries.description: Selectable panels fan out in perspective and exchange front-to-back positions with a spring. Arrow keys and direct tabs reach every panel.
entries.style: Iridescent editorial / 虹彩编辑卡组

entries.name: ProfileCard
entries.description: Animated profile card glare with 3D hover effect.

entries.name: ReflectiveCard
entries.description: Card with dynamic webcam reflection and glare effects that respond to cursor movement.

entries.name: ScrollStack
entries.description: Overlapping card stack reveals on scroll with depth layering.

entries.name: ScrollTheater
entries.description: A scrollable scene with a poster plane, foreground disc and headline moving at different depths. Native scene buttons provide the same destinations without wheel gestures.
entries.style: Constructivist poster / 构成主义剧场

entries.name: ShutterText
entries.description: Large words exchange through alternating 3D shutter rows on a clock. Every word is directly selectable, with pause and reduced-motion alternatives.
entries.style: Split shutter typography / 百叶窗字排

entries.name: SpecularButton
entries.description: Glass button with a shader-driven specular rim light that sweeps around the edge and follows the cursor.

entries.name: SpotlightCard
entries.description: Dynamic spotlight follows cursor casting gradient illumination.

entries.name: Stack
entries.description: Layered stack with swipe animations, autoplay and smooth transitions.

entries.name: StaggeredMenu
entries.description: Menu with staggered item animations and smooth transitions on open/close.

entries.name: Stepper
entries.description: Animated multi-step progress indicator with active state transitions.

entries.name: TiltedCard
entries.description: 3D perspective tilt card reacting to pointer.

entries.name: VinylDeck
entries.description: Analog vinyl artwork with concentric grooves, a lifting tonearm and an explicit visual rotation control.
entries.style: Analog record player / 复古黑胶

entries.name: ArcadeButton
entries.description: Chunky arcade key with a stepped silhouette, hard offset shadow and physical press travel.

entries.name: BellToggle
entries.description: Pill toggle that answers a press at three tempos: the bell rings on damped keyframes, the label blur-crossfades, and the pill unfurls to the longer label through a clip-path on a critically damped spring. The pressed state is the receipt.

entries.name: BranchedMenu
entries.description: Collapsible menu whose sections unfold into a trunk with a curved branch to each child, and an accent line that travels down the trunk and around the curve to whatever you pick, while a marker glides to the open section.

entries.name: BubbleChoice
entries.description: Candy-colored native radio group with round labels and a spring bubble around the selected choice.

entries.name: CallChip
entries.description: Inline tool-call chip whose fill wipes across while a live ms counter ticks, completing with a green wash on success or stopping short and shaking red with a retry glyph on error.

entries.name: CodeSlots
entries.description: One-time-code input where a hidden overlay input owns focus, paste and SMS autofill while each slot lands its digit on one spring: the fill swells from the centre, the digit rises and the caret glides; a wrong code drains the slots in a cascade, a right one merges them into a single accent wash.

entries.name: CometDial
entries.description: Tick-ring dial you flick by angle: the reading launches on a spring and a velocity-driven comet streaks behind the lit head, trailing the direction of travel and vanishing at rest.

entries.name: DodgeField
entries.description: Wrapper that makes any child flee the pointer inside a bounded field, dodges once per approach, then relents after a few tries and glides home.

entries.name: ElasticTabs
entries.description: Soft segmented tabs with a spring-driven shared indicator, preserved panels and roving keyboard focus.

entries.name: FlipCard
entries.description: Two-faced card that flips in 3D on a click, a drag or a flick, settling on a spring that carries your release velocity, with an optional cursor tilt, a sheen that follows the pointer and a shadow that narrows as it turns edge on.

entries.name: FolderFloat
entries.description: Folder that opens on hover or press: the flap tilts toward you, a paper edge rises, and its notes spring out from behind the flap into a floating cloud to pick from, then sink back when the folder closes.

entries.name: FuseButton
entries.description: Action button whose done state carries its own undo on a burning fuse: press, the label crossfades to Undo, a hairline burns for the undo window, and Undo or Escape runs it back.

entries.name: GlideSelect
entries.description: Select chip whose menu pops out of its own corner and whose single hover highlight glides between rows, remembering where you left it so re-entry slides from there instead of blinking in.

entries.name: HoldButton
entries.description: Hold-to-confirm button whose liquid fill rises while pressed, snaps back on an early release and swaps its label through a blur when the hold completes.

entries.name: JellyRadio
entries.description: Radio group of labelled chips where the chosen one swells wide-then-tall on two springs and barges its neighbours outward with a travelling stagger, so a selection reads as a force moving through the row.

entries.name: LatticeLoader
entries.description: Inline agent-status row: a 3x3 or 4x4 lattice whose cells brighten in a phase-offset wave beside a verb and a live stopwatch, resolving into a check or a cross when the task ends.

entries.name: NeonToggle
entries.description: Hardware-inspired switch with a luminous LED lane, etched ticks and a spring slider.

entries.name: OrbitSlider
entries.description: Mint circular instrument with a spring orbit and native keyboard-accessible range input.

entries.name: PaperCrumple
entries.description: An image that crumples into a textured 3D sheet while held and follows the grabbed point as you drag. Release it as a crumpled ball, unfold it flat, or leave the paper creased, with customizable folds, paper grain, lighting and shadows.

entries.name: PaperNote
entries.description: Editable ruled sticky note with a tape tab, live draft callback and pin-controlled paper tilt.

entries.name: PeekRating
entries.description: Star rating you can try before you commit: sweeping the row lifts a trailing wave of stars up to the pointer while a tip hops along with the label; a click commits with a pop.

entries.name: PixelMeter
entries.description: A pixel matrix meter with staggered cell response and a native stepped range control.

entries.name: PostcardFlip
entries.description: A travel postcard with a sunburst cover, postal reverse and an accessible explicit flip control.

entries.name: PromptBar
entries.description: Chat composer with an @ sources menu, a / commands menu, a model picker, dictation and attachments, whose send tile charges to ink the moment there is something to send and morphs its arrow into a stop square while busy.

entries.name: PulseHeart
entries.description: Like button that contracts to a dot, flips colour at its smallest frame and pulses back while the count swaps one glyph.

entries.name: RefineFrame
entries.description: Reserved-aspect frame that walks any media through queued, generating, refining and complete without layout shift: each stage is one blur, saturate, scale and opacity tween, a soft band sweeps while it works, a chip reports the stage, and an error dims the picture behind a retry pill.

entries.name: RibbonBadge
entries.description: A vintage folded ribbon badge that reveals supporting content with an accessible disclosure button.

entries.name: RippleButton
entries.description: Warm tactile button with pointer-origin ripples, centered keyboard feedback and bounded animation nodes.

entries.name: RubberSegment
entries.description: Segmented control with a rubber thumb: taps stretch it across the gap and squash it onto the target, and you can grab, drag and flick it between slots.

entries.name: ScrubField
entries.description: Number chip you drag to scrub: the value follows the hand, pushes past the range on a rubber band, and a click without moving opens it for typing.

entries.name: Shredder
entries.description: A list with a paper shredder at the bottom. Drag a row into the slit and the rollers tug it in, pull it through and cut it into strips that curl out underneath, tumble away and fade out. The rest of the list settles down on a spring and the shredded item is handed to you to delete.

entries.name: SlideCommit
entries.description: Slide-to-confirm handle that plants with a spinner while your action runs, unfurls into a done pill on success and springs home with a squash and shake on failure.

entries.name: SlingButton
entries.description: Send button you pull back like a slingshot: the band stretches, a power arc arms it, and releasing fires the action with the flick's velocity.

entries.name: SloshGauge
entries.description: Tank gauge whose liquid chases the value with mass, tilts with its own speed and splashes against the top when it slams full; optionally a vertical slider.

entries.name: SpringAccordion
entries.description: Editorial ruled accordion with numbered headings and restrained spring expansion.

entries.name: SpringCheck
entries.description: Checkbox row where a single spring fills the box, draws the tick, strikes the label and dims the words in one press.

entries.name: SquishSwitch
entries.description: Drag-scrubbable switch whose thumb stretches by how fast it moves, flips at the midpoint and squashes against the track end on a flick.

entries.name: StatusMark
entries.description: A 20px status glyph for agent task lists that morphs in place from a dashed idle ring to a spinning or real-progress arc, then draws a check or a cross, with an optional label strike.

entries.name: SwipeRow
entries.description: List row that swipes open to reveal actions, snaps by flick velocity, and deletes on a full swipe that stretches the action colour across the row.

entries.name: SwipeToast
entries.description: Single toast that rises through its bottom edge, swipes down to dismiss on a flick or a distance, and burns a thin fuse for exactly its remaining time; hover pauses it and an inline mode keeps it inside any container.

entries.name: TearTicket
entries.description: Ticket whose perforated stub tears off by hand: paper bridges stretch into fibres and snap one by one from the far end, the torn edges are jagged and fit each other, the freed stub dangles and drops, and the body is stamped as used. The artwork tilts in 3D with parallax on hover.

entries.name: TerminalStatus
entries.description: A phosphor terminal status display driven by explicit caller-owned idle, running, success or error state.

entries.name: ThoughtLine
entries.description: Reasoning-trace header: a glyph and a label breathe beside a live clock while steps appear beneath, then the line settles on one beat into "Thought for 4.2s" through a blur crossfade and the trace folds into it.

entries.name: ToastStack
entries.description: Frosted toast stack that unfolds on hover or keyboard focus, with inaccessible exit nodes and stable focus after dismissal.

entries.name: VoicePill
entries.description: Mic button that swells into a tinted capsule of level-driven equalizer bars and an elapsed clock while held or toggled, then relaxes back into the mic on release; simulated voice by default, real microphone as an opt-in.

entries.name: WakeSlider
entries.description: Range slider drawn as thin bars with no thumb: drag speed raises a wake that trails behind the handle and flattens again at rest.

entries.name: WarmTooltip
entries.description: Tooltip group with one shared delay: the first label waits and pops from its trigger, then siblings open instantly while the group is warm, with an optional velocity lean.

entries.name: ASCIIText
entries.description: Renders text with an animated ASCII background for a retro feel.

entries.name: BlurText
entries.description: Text starts blurred then crisply resolves for a soft-focus reveal effect.

entries.name: CircularText
entries.description: Layouts characters around a circle with optional rotation animation.

entries.name: CountUp
entries.description: Animated number counter supporting formatting and decimals.

entries.name: CurvedLoop
entries.description: Flowing looping text path along a customizable curve with drag interaction.

entries.name: DecryptedText
entries.description: Hacker-style decryption cycling random glyphs until resolving to real text.

entries.name: DepthText
entries.description: Layered extruded type with parallax that shifts against the pointer.

entries.name: EchoText
entries.description: Ghosted copies trail behind the text and settle into a single word.

entries.name: FallingText
entries.description: Characters fall with gravity + bounce creating a playful entrance.

entries.name: FoldText
entries.description: Lines unfold into place like creased paper opening flat.

entries.name: FuzzyText
entries.description: Vibrating fuzzy text with controllable hover intensity.

entries.name: GlitchText
entries.description: RGB split and distortion glitch effect with jitter effects.

entries.name: GradientText
entries.description: Animated gradient sweep across live text with speed and color control.

entries.name: MaskedHeading
entries.description: A large headline with a drifting colour mesh or image showing through the glyphs, revealed word by word.

entries.name: ParticleText
entries.description: Text assembles from drifting particles that scatter and reform on demand.

entries.name: RotatingText
entries.description: Cycles through multiple phrases with 3D rotate / flip transitions.

entries.name: ScrambledText
entries.description: Detects cursor position and applies a distortion effect to text.

entries.name: ScrollFloat
entries.description: Text gently floats / parallax shifts on scroll.

entries.name: ScrollReveal
entries.description: Text gently unblurs and reveals on scroll.

entries.name: ScrollVelocity
entries.description: Text marquee animatio - speed and distortion scale with user's scroll velocity.

entries.name: ShinyText
entries.description: Metallic sheen sweeps across text producing a reflective highlight.

entries.name: Shuffle
entries.description: Animated text reveal where characters shuffle before settling.

entries.name: SplitFlapText
entries.description: Mechanical split-flap departure board that clacks through to each new phrase.

entries.name: SplitText
entries.description: Splits text into characters / words for staggered entrance animation.

entries.name: StrokeText
entries.description: Outlined letterforms draw themselves on, then flood with fill.

entries.name: TechText
entries.description: A wordmark whose letters turn into dashed vector paths under the cursor. Grab any letter to drag it off the baseline and it springs back home.

entries.name: TextCursor
